verdict.rationale: Supermemory doesn't document a dedicated 'export all data' feature in an open format, but its API (search/add endpoints, OpenAPI spec) lets a user programmatically pull all memories, and its self-hosting option lets data live entirely on your own hardware — both are partial paths to portability rather than a one-click export-and-leave tool. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk data-export/download feature, documented open export format (e.g., JSON/CSV dump), and any evidence users have actually used it to migrate away.
